text:
Sam H: Quick heads-up — pen test scheduled Thu 2024-05-09 09:00-13:00 PT. Need: RBAC snapshot, KMS access plan, audit log export, vuln triage owner, and retest window. Can we lock a 2h readroom on Wed (10-12 PT)? CC @Lia P @Jordan C
Lia P: Wed 10-12 PT works for Security squad. Which environments? staging or prod read-only?
Jordan C: Staging only for active exploit validation. We can provide sanitized prod logs but not keys. For audit logs we can prepare a presigned S3 with last 7 days. @Kevin S fyi on keystore rotations.
Kevin S: Ok re: keystore: we need to rotate the staging KMS key Tuesday evening to ensure fresh CMKs. Propose ephemeral roles via STS assume-role with duration 3600s. Example policy:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-efgh"}
  ]
}
```
Sam H: Good. For RBAC snapshot — can devex produce a mapping of service -> roles + last modified? Use `rbac-export --since 2023-01-01`.
Lia P: I can run export and attach. Note: we should mask any PII. Also we need to audit-log filter: include admin actions, assume-role, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey.
assessor-bot: New assessment created: ASSESS-2024-0412. Upload evidence to presigned bucket at https://s3-presigned.example/ASSESS-2024-0412 (expires in 7d)
Jordan C: For vuln triage, prefer JIRA epic RED-PT-2024 and label fix PRs with `pt-remediate`. QA will run regression tests against canary model. Assign triage lead?
Sam H: Assign to Jordan.
Jordan C: I'll own triage. Can we get a table of CVE id, component, risk, repro steps, ETA?
Kevin S: We'll add CVE -> service mapping. Also note rotation will cause a short 30s decrypt failure window; we should schedule rotation at 02:00 PT Tue to minimize impact.
Lia P: Retest: propose 2 retest slots next week: Mon 09:00-11:00 PT and Thu 14:00-16:00 PT. Which works for assessors?
assessor-bot: Assessor availability: Mon OK, Thu tentative.
Sam H: Action items: Lia export RBAC + audit filters by EOD today; Kevin schedule KMS rotation + create ephemeral role; Jordan track triage in RED-PT-2024; I will confirm readroom and presigned bucket. Anyone object?
Kevin S: lgtm :thumbsup:
Lia P: lgtm
Jordan C: lgtm
Sam H: Thanks — I'll post final runbook tomorrow. /cc @security-oncall
